title: Annex A.8 - Information for interested parties
description: Working paper for Annex A.8: system information for users and other interested parties; reporting; communication of incidents.

sections.title: System information for users (A.8.2)
prompts: Verify user-facing AI documentation (purpose, limitations, opt-out).
Confirm content matches the actual system behaviour (no overclaiming).

sections.title: External reporting (A.8.3)
prompts: Confirm transparency notices, where required by law.

sections.title: Communication of incidents (A.8.4)
prompts: Sample an AI incident; verify external communication followed policy.
Confirm timing meets regulatory and contractual obligations.

checklists.text: User-facing AI notice exists and is current.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Show us the AI notice on the live product surface.
Walk us through a recent regulator notification.
How do you decide if an AI incident is externally reportable?
